name: Dolly Parton Imagination Library
description: Free book mailed monthly to child's home for kids (up to age 5), in English or bilingual English/Spanish; builds home library of up to 60 books by kindergarten
fullDescription: Dolly Parton's Imagination Library sends a free, high-quality book every month to registered children from birth to age five, regardless of family income. The Imagination Library of California is expanding county by county with State of California matching funds (42 counties as of March 2026).
whatTheyOffer:
- Free book mailed monthly
- For children birth to age 5
- High-quality, age-appropriate books
- English or bilingual English/Spanish books
- Build library of up to 60 books
- Delivered directly to your home
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Imagination Library of California page
2. Check availability for your address and register (takes under 5 minutes)
3. Enter your child's information and mailing address
4. Register each eligible child separately
5. First book arrives within 8-12 weeks
6. Books continue monthly until age 5
keywords: Dolly Parton, free books, children's books, early literacy, birth to five, monthly book, Imagination Library, reading
